<Heading as={'h1'} className={'openapi__heading'} children={'Replace a draft'}></Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={'put'}
  path={'/v1/admin/workflows/{workflowId}/versions/{version}'}
  context={'endpoint'}
></MethodEndpoint>

Replaces the draft with the document, which may carry a new `id` and `version` when that target is free: it must not name an existing revision in any status, a second draft, or a family outside the `users` scope. A family left with no versions is deleted. A draft an onboarding references cannot be replaced. The label is written only when the call creates the target family.
